description: This file implements a singleton Swift class NotifyOverlayController that provides in-app 'toast'-like notification overlays on macOS, bypassing the system Notification Center. It manages the creation and presentation of a custom NSPanel window with SwiftUI content, including methods for presenting and dismissing notifications, and calculates dynamic height based on content.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayController
classes.description: A singleton controller managing in-app toast notifications with a SwiftUI-based overlay window.

classes.name: NotifyOverlayView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view displaying the notification's title and body, and handling tap dismissal.

methods.name: present
methods.description: Displays the notification with specified title and body, auto-dismisses after a delay if provided.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Hides and dismisses the notification overlay.

methods.name: ensureWindow
methods.description: Creates and initializes the overlay window if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: targetFrame
methods.description: Computes the position and size of the notification window on the main screen.

methods.name: updateWindowFrame
methods.description: Animates and updates the position of the overlay window to the target frame.

methods.name: measuredHeight
methods.description: Calculates the dynamic height of the notification overlay based on content size.
